Confidence scores reflect urgency, epidemiology, and symptom specificity: intussusception and volvulus are assigned highest confidence due to life-threatening implications and classic presentation pattern; hernia and UTI follow based on prevalence and diagnostic mimicry; gastroenteritis is downgraded due to lack of supportive features and atypical severity."}
